observations.description: An England attacker drives into the France box on the ground and is challenged by two defenders, with one sliding in from the side as the ball stays near the attacker's feet.
The referee points toward the penalty spot after the challenge in the area, while players around the incident appeal with raised arms.
England's number 9 begins the penalty kick run-up from the spot with the referee beside the area and France's goalkeeper set on the goal line.
The penalty is struck low into the left side of the goal as the goalkeeper dives the other way and the ball crosses the line into the net.
England's number 9 runs away along the byline with arms out in celebration after scoring.
Replay: England's number 9 strikes the penalty with his right foot from the spot.
Replay: the ball rises into the goal after the penalty, visibly inside the net.
